content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text issues UNDERDETERMINED for a dispute about Luke 2:48-49 and bases that label on the verse's \"thy father\" phrase being qualified by \"my Father's business,\" so it is doing the single-verse/two-sense thing the rule governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] §5 and [CR3] LINK 4; Mary's phrase \"thy father\" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to \"my Father's business.\"","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.","room":"none","why":"The judge's UNDERDETERMINED treats Luke 2:48-49 as open because it carries both \"thy father\" and \"my Father's business,\" but K-S2 says such a verse is not open and both senses stand."}
